create_RobotInterface_subclass: create a subclass of RobotInterface that implements update, reset, and reconfigure abstract methods
get_robot_sim_id: get the unique simulation object ID for a robot instance via get_robot_sim_id
get_link_and_joint_names: get a debug string listing all robot link and joint names with their types
set_motor_position: set a robot joint motor position target using _set_motor_pos with a joint index and control value
capture_robot_state: capture the current robot state including joint forces, velocities, and positions via _capture_robot_state
